title: Eliminate discarded QND ancillas into a finite positive task model
statement: Actual QND readout and discard remove cross-syndrome terms; retired matched Pauli frames yield positive environment effects indexed by logical Pauli and virtual terminal syndrome. Their current weights give an exact task likelihood, not a classical environment simulator.

requires: Declared complete weak QND instruments, actual local Pauli/routing/isolation/buffers, selectable native entangling port and real forward quantum carriers. Terminal ancillas do not reinteract before discard. Current private frame/axis/role settings are hidden from the macro and decoder; keys are retired. Known likelihood kernel and bounded padded schedules are essential.
provides: Actual QND readout and discard remove cross-syndrome terms; retired matched Pauli frames yield positive environment effects indexed by logical Pauli and virtual terminal syndrome. Their current weights give an exact task likelihood, not a classical environment simulator.
assumptions: The fitted calibration-history mixture need not predict arbitrary future environments. Adaptive regret is a model-average statement, not a uniform per-record guarantee; the actual capped record has gap about .33348. The outer beta bound is accepted error WEIGHT with the same accepted environment filter, not conditional accepted error <=1/64. Conditioning, arbitrary drift, useful yield, whole-stream accuracy and protected-buffer alternatives remain distinct. Equally informed conventional Bayesian controllers can use the same weights and policy. The reported calibration worst-case l1 radius is about .514, too loose as a small standalone prediction certificate. Native quantum operations are specified in the computer model, not demonstrated hardware.
costs: For six ancillas the model has 256 dyadic weights; dependence is exponential in boundary size. Source-reported adaptive control uses 252,786 inner marks over 8,192 macros (mean 30.857666), but padded duration does not shrink. It also pays 147,456 native CNOTs, 57,344 carriers, 2,824,306 total weak marks and fresh private coordination. A rejected unknown input is consumed. Finite counter/precision/key and reset costs remain; no hardware throughput or universal efficiency advantage follows.
contract.units: Task weights, G and beta are dimensionless probabilities/risks; retained description is measured in bits. Probes, carriers and native gates are actual counts; elapsed time remains padded.
contract.obstruction: No general fault-tolerance threshold, arbitrary future-model compression or infinite-stream guarantee is established. Response complexity can require 2^m[1-h2(error)] retained bits even for a memoryless device; reacquisition is a different paid interface. Completed supplied internal operation audits are retained at their actual model/code scope; this intake does not replay native experiments.

body: For diagonal K_w=sum_mu k_w(mu)Pi_mu, partial trace over the actual discarded ancillas annihilates cross terms. Pauli-frame retirement yields noncommuting positive effects F_smu on continuing memory, with weights Tr(F_smu rho_M). Paired sacrificial weak logical audits and the known majority kernel acquire a calibration-history mixture; invert the kernel, project and quantize. A changed or adaptive terminal kernel is evaluated on actually received branches only. The representation remains exponential in boundary width and does not acquire arbitrary future laws.
